title: First Alert corpus import
description: Import the local First Alert audio export folder into a new Biblicus corpus. Definition of Done: source folder is ingested into a new corpus, catalog is built, counts are verified, and Git/Kanbus state is recorded.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: First Alert corpus import is complete and verified. The corpus data lives under corpora/first-alert, which is ignored by Git according to corpora/.gitignore; Kanbus tracking files will be committed.
